policy_catalog.rationale: CEFR descriptors define activity, competence, and qualitative level boundaries; they support the spine but are not a lesson inventory.
Adult GSE objectives are granular evidence for communicative progression; published scores remain source facts rather than automatic lesson owners.
EGP features are productively attested grammar evidence to reconcile with communicative need; inclusion does not make each feature a lesson.
GSE Grammar is a productive grammar cross-check; exact ownership is a later progression-strand decision.
Oxford 3000 supplies a levelled lexical pool through B2, not an automatic target list or teaching order.
Oxford 5000 supplies additional B2-C1 lexical evidence, not an automatic target list and not a C2 lexical specification.

limitations: Acceptance records a reviewed classification policy plus complete exception audit; it does not claim manual item-by-item pedagogical judgment.
Semantic cross-source equivalence and exact lifecycle ownership belong to SPINE-004 progression mapping.
Oxford evidence remains a reference pool; C2 lexical methodology requires a separate corpus- and domain-informed design.
